canonical_claim: Neural Bridge demonstrates controlled future human arousal event-ranking across VEATIC and AGAIN, plus controlled grouped held-out-video continuous future-arousal movement ranking/lift on AGAIN, from frozen predicted cortical/fMRI response features generated from video by upstream models trained on brain cortical response data.
headline_result: Phase 7 passed a fresh 420/420 grouped held-out-video continuous checkpoint-ensemble confirmation with all 15/15 fold-groups and 5/5 fold means positive versus target-specific AR and matched controls on Spearman and top-5% lift; failed gates were empty.
headline_magnitude: Within the original grouped AGAIN spike target, Neural Bridge raised raw cortical PR-AUC from 0.136579 to 0.2383409298 (+74.51%) and finished 39.95% above direct AR-plus-raw. Versus the original validated continuous bridge, Phase 7 improves Spearman 16.61%, top-5% lift 23.59%, top-1% lift 14.52%, and the top-5% margin beyond AR 98.92%.

value_interpretation.interpretation: These are last-mile lifts over a trained target-specific persistence model that already captures the dominant easy signal, not total-system value. The developmental transformation is from raw cortical features having negative incremental value to the real bridge adding positive signal in all 15/15 grouped fold-groups.

phase7_supporting_event_from_continuous.status: supporting secondary metric, not a primary Phase 7 promotion gate

value_interpretation.cross_task_warning: The early PR-AUC ablation and Phase 7 continuous metrics use different targets and metrics; do not divide them into one cross-task percentage. Whole-generation comparisons must be labeled separately from matched within-protocol claims.

baseline_definitions.ar_only: Standalone trained target-specific persistence model using observed current arousal, lag-1/2/4 arousal, and recent deltas.
baseline_definitions.trained_ar: AR fit for the exact target, split, fold, and seed with checkpoint selection on training-side inner validation.
baseline_definitions.frozen_ar: The trained AR checkpoint's predictions fixed before residual/control training and reused identically beneath every real and matched-control lane.
baseline_definitions.raw_cortical_only: Simple model over a deterministic projection of upstream predicted cortical/fMRI features without the Neural Bridge stack.
baseline_definitions.ar_plus_raw_cortical: Direct concatenation of AR context and raw cortical projection; it tested whether brute-force feature addition was sufficient.
baseline_definitions.neural_bridge_residual: Correction learned over frozen AR using fold-safe neuro-response PCA, causal temporal/event context, and the selected future target/head.
baseline_definitions.phase7_checkpoint_ensemble: Equal-weight average of three independently trained, prespecified Neural Bridge residual checkpoints.

VEATIC-124 v2.status: established original controlled future arousal spike/event-ranking signal
VEATIC-124 v2.dataset_definition: 124 edited affect-video clips from Hollywood movies, documentaries, reality TV shows, and home videos, with continuous valence/arousal annotation.
VEATIC-124 v2.domain_generalization_role: film, TV/reality, documentary, and home-video emotion benchmark

AGAIN dense 2Hz.role: scaled confirmation and current main result
AGAIN dense 2Hz.status: replicated, validated, and strengthened event-ranking evidence at scale

cache.row_description: video feature rows generated from video by upstream models trained on brain cortical response data

AGAIN dense 2Hz.dataset_definition: Gaming/interactive-media arousal corpus: 1,116 raw in-game videos/logs, 995 cleaned videos used here, 124 participants, 9 games, 3 genres, and more than 37 hours of annotated video/logs.

proven: Controlled future human arousal event-ranking from frozen predicted cortical/fMRI response features generated from video by upstream models trained on brain cortical response data across VEATIC and AGAIN.
VEATIC-124 v2 established the original controlled future arousal spike/event-ranking signal.
AGAIN replicated and extended the result at scale.
Bounded strict forward-time future-event ranking is proven on AGAIN for future_arousal_max_delta_rows_4_10_train_q90 with short_temporal_conv_residual.
Grouped held-out-video compatibility for the same AGAIN target/head is proven under the updated frozen-AR-residual-aware verdict.
The full bounded AGAIN selected-head confirmation passes at exactly 420/420 scored rows: 70/70 blocked plus 350/350 grouped, with all 420 rows reused, zero reruns, and no failed gates.

The original three-checkpoint ensemble passes separate fresh control-complete blocked and grouped-video confirmations for the selected AGAIN target/head: 140/140 blocked rows and 420/420 grouped rows, both with no failed gates.

Controlled grouped held-out-video continuous future-arousal movement ranking/lift is proven on AGAIN for the deterministic Phase 5 eval-mode regression_plus_binary lane against AR-only and matched shuffled/random controls.

The separately preregistered Phase 7 washout-target checkpoint ensemble independently passed grouped continuous future-movement ranking/lift at exactly 420/420 rows, with all 15/15 fold-groups and 5/5 fold means positive versus AR and matched controls.
open: Fully confirmed blocked continuous future-movement generalization remains open: the separate Phase 7 blocked run was a strong aggregate near-pass but missed its locked 5/5 Spearman-vs-AR group gate at 4/5.
Direct label-free client-video deployment remains open because the current strongest residual benchmark consumes observed current/past arousal context.
Broad all-target/all-dataset temporal prediction remains open.
No 504 run has been performed or promoted.
Grouped compatibility is not itself a 504 run.
The updated grouped verdict is a no-training verdict update from existing artifacts, not a rerun.

next_task.objective: Phase 7 grouped continuous checkpoint-ensemble confirmation completed and promoted; next bounded hypothesis is a video-only student or cold-start/self-rollout bridge that removes observed arousal context from client inference.
next_task.reuse_policy: The Phase 7 grouped run freshly trained model and target-specific AR lanes for nine untouched seeds in each grouped fold; only the previously audited fold-safe grouped PCA substrate was reused.
next_task.historical_504_boundary: The literal 504 matrix was an older 3-seed x 4-variant x 7-lane development design across one blocked split and five grouped folds. It is not the current task and is not 420 current rows plus 84 missing rows.
next_task.stop_boundary: Do not reinterpret the blocked 4/5 near-pass, claim exact continuous values, equate benchmark teacher-forced AR context with label-free client deployment, restore 504, or begin a deployment-bridge sweep without a locked protocol.

again_grouped_continuous_future_movement.boundary: Controlled grouped continuous future-movement ranking/lift passed; exact continuous values and blocked continuous generalization remain open.

again_phase7_grouped_continuous_checkpoi.boundary: Promoted only for grouped held-out-video continuous future-movement ranking/lift on the selected target/head. The separate blocked run remains a literal 4/5 near-pass; exact values and label-free deployment are not proven.

again_raw_cortical_alone_failure.interpretation: raw predicted cortical/fMRI features alone were insufficient on the blocked AGAIN target; the Neural Bridge pipeline raised PR-AUC by +0.1427585630 over raw-cortical-only, a +114.84% relative lift, showing that the bridge creates the usable controlled signal

claim_update_policy: Claim boundaries describe the current evidence state, not permanent bans. A new valid executable pass supersedes stale cautious wording and must be promoted and stated plainly after canonical files are updated; a failed gate remains a failure until new valid evidence changes it.
not_currently_proven: blocked continuous future-movement generalization is solved
exact continuous arousal forecasting is solved
broad all-target/all-dataset temporal prediction is solved
use holy_shit_pass as a valid gate

executable_validation.policy: Only deterministic contract tests, claim-bearing runners, no-training verdict/audit scripts, and documented runtime tools are indexed. Runtime probes are not claim-bearing benchmark evidence.

commercial_summary: Neural Bridge is being built to convert pre-release video response evaluation from a slow human service into scalable software. Phase 7 proves the core controlled future-response ranking intelligence; the next video-only deployment bridge removes the current benchmark's observed-arousal input before raw client-video operation is claimed.
primary_wedge: pre-release creative response intelligence for video
commercial_guardrails: Describe Neural Bridge as bounded response intelligence, not mind reading.
Do not claim individual emotion prediction or individual profiling.
Do not claim medical or mental-health inference.
Do not claim exact continuous arousal forecasting is solved.
Do not claim universal emotion prediction.
Do not claim guaranteed campaign performance.
Do not claim replacement of editors, researchers, or panels; describe upstream decision support and selective human review.
Do not claim full multimodal proof unless separately validated.

service_as_software.one_liner: Neural Bridge is Service as Software for neuro-response video intelligence.
service_as_software.core_phrase: Neural Bridge converts pre-release video response evaluation from a slow human service into scalable software using predicted cortical/fMRI response features generated from video by upstream models trained on brain cortical response data.
service_as_software.customer_outcome: Tell us which parts of this video are likely to work, which are weak, and which variant we should test or ship.
service_as_software.neuro_response_core: The system uses frozen video-side features trained from brain cortical response data; the claim is future human arousal event ranking from that neuro-response representation, not generic video analytics.

metric_definitions.pr_auc: Area under the precision-recall curve; primary ranking metric for rare future arousal events.
metric_definitions.relative_lift_percent: PR-AUC delta divided by the comparison score, such as +0.0068399399 / 0.2602336231 = +2.63%.
metric_definitions.ar_or_frozen_ar: Autoregressive baseline using recent/past arousal; intentionally strong because arousal is temporally persistent.
metric_definitions.blocked_temporal_70_30: Forward-time split testing future temporal generalization.
metric_definitions.pr_auc_delta: Difference between two PR-AUC scores, such as 0.2670735630 - 0.2602336231 = +0.0068399399.
metric_definitions.ar_only_baseline: Standalone autoregressive comparison lane using recent/past arousal information.
metric_definitions.frozen_ar: Matched seed/fold-specific AR-only score or logit fixed before residual/control training and reused identically across real and matched controls in that seed/fold. It may be reused from a compatible checkpoint/score or newly trained for that exact seed/fold when missing.
metric_definitions.best_matched_control: The strongest matched control lane for the same target/protocol/head family, used as the control hurdle alongside the matched AR/frozen floor.

neuro_response_framing.upstream_substrate: TRIBE/V-JEPA provide frozen predicted cortical/fMRI response features generated from video by upstream models trained on brain cortical response data.
neuro_response_framing.neural_bridge_role: Neural Bridge is the downstream bridge/control/validation/reporting layer that turns those predicted neuro-response features into controlled future human arousal event-ranking.
not_the_claim: direct neural recordings from benchmark viewers

ar_baseline_significance.why_it_matters: AR/frozen AR is the strong recent-arousal persistence baseline; beating the matched seed/fold-specific frozen AR floor and best matched controls shows the bridge is not merely following arousal momentum.

upstream_model_compounding.summary: Neural Bridge is designed to compound with future upstream brain-response models: as TRIBE/V-JEPA-like systems improve, they can provide stronger frozen predicted cortical/fMRI signal for the same bridge, control, validation, and response-reporting layer.
upstream_model_compounding.guardrail: This does not claim automatic proof for future models; each upgraded substrate still needs the same controls and validation.
